analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($77.58) vs SMA5/20/50 ($81.79/$88.26/$91.78) — Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming bearish trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($82.44)/SMA200 ($76.48) — Below SMA100, approaching SMA200, indicating weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (47.1%) + Approaching historical low price range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.7→32.1) — Continues in oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.5329→-1.1983) — Bearish trend persists, worsening after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $79.29) — Approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($69.44) — Based on Pivot S1 ($71.47) and weekly SMA50 ($74.58).
· Swing resistance ($94.48) — Based on Pivot R1 ($89.67) and SMA20 ($88.26).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High) — Confirms continuation of the downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.80x) — Reinforces the downtrend, indicating seller dominance.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend) — High probability of further decline, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
